title: The Trust Calibration Maturity Model for Characterizing and Communicating Trustworthiness of AI Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated through the Trust Calibration Maturity Model (TCMM), which provides a scoring rubric (Levels 1-4) to assess whether an AI system identifies, measures, and communicates known biases originating from training data, sample selection, or historical context.

Evaluated via the Trust Calibration Maturity Model (TCMM) by assessing the degree to which systematic errors inherent in model design, feature selection, and architecture are quantified and communicated to the user.

Conceptually identified as a human-centric risk when human-AI interaction is involved (especially when reasoning is obscure or statistical confidence is high), though it is not empirically measured in the paper's demonstrations.
